title: Noor and the Debt
author: Gideon Vasquez
blurb: Felix Nakamura, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, works cases no one wants attributed. But when a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must get the truth past three governments and one assassin, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
